author: Cobratate
text:
At 39 you can not fight like you can at 25.

However, counterintuitively, age makes you better at showing love and taking damage.

Age gives a man a larger heart and thicker skin.

You suffer better.

You love more.

You’re a better person, and although you can not attack the same.

You absorb difficulty better than ever. Practice makes perfect.
